extraction_x.question_used_for_analysis: Where is an accepted record handed off, at what invocation granularity is it transformed, and when is it reduced?

fused_handoff.meaning: accepted records pass directly to transformation

retained_handoff.meaning: accepted records form a retained compact sequence

compact_block64_dispatch.meaning: one transformation invocation per compact block

running_reduction.meaning: update the aggregate as values become available

deferred_reduction.meaning: retain transformed values and reduce once

compatibility: both reduction modes require associative integer addition

extraction_y.question_used_for_analysis: In what shape does work reach transformation, and how is the batch completed?

direct_item_feed.meaning: filtering and item-sized transformation form one online feed

compacted_batch_feed.meaning: selection and block dispatch jointly produce compact batches

rolling_fold.meaning: completion consists of repeated fold events

collected_finish.meaning: completion stores outputs and performs one terminal fold

compatibility: both completion modes require associative integer addition
deliberate_non_alignment: compacted_batch_feed absorbs retention and dispatch granularity instead of exposing two axes
buffer reads and writes are represented as aggregate traffic because they occur in pairs in the observed sources
no retained per-record feed is inferred because this lens found no such source behavior
